KAIXUAN WANG / 王凯萱
Chinese contemporary painter and independent theorist based in Shenzhen, China.

Primary media:
Watercolor, oil painting, printmaking.

Core themes:
Architecture, memory, materiality, lived environments, human presence, relation, softness.

Canonical site:
https://kaixuanwang.art/

Key pages:

Books: https://kaixuanwang.art/books.html
References: https://kaixuanwang.art/references.html
